name: SEEKER_AT_THE_DOOR
canonical: a seeker hesitating at the threshold, an ancient Near-Eastern figure of indeterminate middle years with olive skin and a downcast ashamed face, shoulders hunched and head lowered, wrapped in a plain travel-worn earth-toned robe and head-cloth, one hesitant hand half-raised at the dim open doorway of a stone dwelling
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
